description: This Java source file defines the OverlayDataNormalizer class, which normalizes overlay data colors based on luminance and contrast requirements for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes methods for luminance calculation, normalization logic, and an inner class for normalized overlay data.

classes.name: OverlayDataNormalizer
classes.description: A class that normalizes overlay data colors to ensure sufficient contrast and readability based on luminance calculations.

classes.name: OverlayDataNormalized
classes.description: An inner class implementing OverlayData that provides normalized primary and secondary text colors along with other overlay data.

methods.name: OverlayDataNormalizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the normalizer with the original overlay data creator and the required text color difference.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Static method that adjusts overlay data colors based on luminance and contrast requirements.

methods.name: createOverlayData
methods.description: Creates overlay data for a given remote app component, applying normalization.

methods.name: luminance
methods.description: Calculates the luminance of a color based on its red, green, and blue components.
